newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER RISES, VOLUME EDGES DOWN.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER RISES, VOLUME EDGES DOWN.

text.p: Turnover rose but traded volume was little changed at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Turnover grew to 378,370 denars from 290,270 at the previous session on Thursday and traded volume edged down to 357 shares from 361.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold 176 shares at 1,070 denars and 181 at 1,050 denars, down from 1,070 denars at the last trading and below par of 2,423 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
